author: Veritas III
title: Veritas III - SOTA Optimization: Gradient Clipping (Norm 0.5, Seed 7)
abstract: This experiment investigates the effect of gradient clipping on the stability and performance of Veritas II's SOTA architecture. The global gradient clipping norm is set to 0.5 (reduced from 1.0) to assess if a more aggressive clipping helps stabilize training, particularly for the sensitive CRI-Off task. BASE_SEED=7 is used for direct comparison with previous baseline runs.

import sys
sys.path.append('storage/veritas') # Import from lineage storage
from utils import DSConvDilatedBlock, DSConvNetworkWrapper # Reusing modular components

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
from jax import random
import optax
from typing import Any, Dict, Sequence

# --- Prediction Head Modules ---
class RegressionHead(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    dense_dim: int = 128 # Smaller intermediate dimension for task-specific heads
    dropout_rate: float = 0.1

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='head_dense_1')(x)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name='out_proj')(z)
        return logits.squeeze(-1) # For single regression output

class MultiLabelRegressionHead(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    dense_dim: int = 128
    dropout_rate: float = 0.1

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='head_dense_1')(x)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name='out_proj')(z)
        return logits # No squeeze for multi-label regression

class MultiLabelClassificationHead(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    dense_dim: int = 128
    dropout_rate: float = 0.1

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='head_dense_1')(x)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name='out_proj')(z)
        return logits # No squeeze for multi-label classification

class MultiClassClassificationHead(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    dense_dim: int = 128
    dropout_rate: float = 0.1

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='head_dense_1')(x)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name='out_proj')(z)
        return logits # No squeeze for multi-class classification


# --- Main Network: Dual-Path (DSConv Hybrid Pooling + Conv-Motif Detector) with Task-Specific Heads ---
class DualPathTaskSpecificHeadNetwork(nn.Module):
    d_input: int = 4
    d_output: int = 1 # This will be passed to the specific head
    task_type: str = "regression" # This will determine which head to use

    d_model_common: int = 256
    ds_num_blocks: int = 5
    ds_dilations: Sequence[int] = (1, 2, 4, 8, 16)
    ds_kernel_size: int = 7
    motif_kernel_size: int = 5
    dropout_rate: float = 0.1 # Uniform global dropout

    # Intermediate dimension for task-specific heads
    head_intermediate_dim: int = 128

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # x shape: (batch, seq_len, d_input)

        # Initial Dense layer to project input to d_model_common
        x = nn.Dense(self.d_model_common, name="initial_dense")(x)
        x = nn.gelu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # 1. Shared DSConv Dilated Blocks for local feature extraction
        for i in range(self.ds_num_blocks):
            dilation = self.ds_dilations[i] if i < len(self.ds_dilations) else self.ds_dilations[-1]
            x = DSConvDilatedBlock(
                d_model=self.d_model_common,
                kernel_size=self.ds_kernel_size,
                dilation=dilation,
                dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate,
                name=f"dsconv_block_{i}"
            )(x, deterministic=deterministic)
        cnn_features = x # Output from the shared backbone

        # 2. Main Path: Hybrid Pooling (Global Mean + Global Max Pooling)
        mean_pooled = jnp.mean(cnn_features, axis=1)
        max_pooled = jnp.max(cnn_features, axis=1)
        main_path_features = jnp.concatenate([mean_pooled, max_pooled], axis=-1)

        # 3. Specialized Path: Conv-Motif Detector + Global Max Pooling
        motif_features = nn.Conv(
            features=self.d_model_common,
            kernel_size=(self.motif_kernel_size,),
            padding='SAME',
            name='motif_conv_1'
        )(cnn_features)
        motif_features = nn.gelu(motif_features)
        motif_features = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(motif_features, deterministic=deterministic)

        specialized_path_features = jnp.max(motif_features, axis=1)

        # 4. Feature Fusion
        fused_features = jnp.concatenate([main_path_features, specialized_path_features], axis=-1)
        fused_features = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(fused_features, deterministic=deterministic)

        # Layer Normalization before task-specific heads
        z_fused = nn.LayerNorm(name="final_norm")(fused_features)

        # 5. Task-Specific Prediction Head
        # The hparams['task_type'] will guide the selection of the head
        if self.task_type == "regression": # APA, CRI-Off, CRI-On, MRL
            logits = RegressionHead(d_output=self.d_output, dense_dim=self.head_intermediate_dim, dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate, name='regression_head')(z_fused, deterministic=deterministic)
        elif self.task_type == "multilabel_regression": # PRS
            logits = MultiLabelRegressionHead(d_output=self.d_output, dense_dim=self.head_intermediate_dim, dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate, name='multilabel_regression_head')(z_fused, deterministic=deterministic)
        elif self.task_type == "multilabel_classification": # Modif
            logits = MultiLabelClassificationHead(d_output=self.d_output, dense_dim=self.head_intermediate_dim, dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate, name='multilabel_classification_head')(z_fused, deterministic=deterministic)
        elif self.task_type == "multiclass_classification": # ncRNA
            logits = MultiClassClassificationHead(d_output=self.d_output, dense_dim=self.head_intermediate_dim, dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate, name='multiclass_classification_head')(z_fused, deterministic=deterministic)
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown task type: {self.task_type}")

        return logits

# Hyperparameter definition
def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'd_model_common': 256,
        'ds_num_blocks': 5,
        'ds_dilations': (1, 2, 4, 8, 16),
        'ds_kernel_size': 7,
        'motif_kernel_size': 5,
        'dropout_rate': 0.1,
        'head_intermediate_dim': 128,
    }

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    model = DualPathTaskSpecificHeadNetwork(
        d_input=4,
        d_output=hparams.get('d_output', 1),
        task_type=hparams.get('task_type', 'regression'),
        d_model_common=hparams.get('d_model_common', 256),
        ds_num_blocks=hparams.get('ds_num_blocks', 5),
        ds_dilations=tuple(hparams.get('ds_dilations', [1, 2, 4, 8, 16])),
        ds_kernel_size=hparams.get('ds_kernel_size', 7),
        motif_kernel_size=hparams.get('motif_kernel_size', 5),
        dropout_rate=hparams.get('dropout_rate', 0.1),
        head_intermediate_dim=hparams.get('head_intermediate_dim', 128),
    )
    return DSConvNetworkWrapper(model) # Using modularized wrapper

def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 0.001):
    """
    Create and return the AdamW optimizer with global norm clipping.
    The global clipping norm is modified for this experiment.
    """
    return optax.chain(
        optax.clip_by_global_norm(0.5), # MODIFIED: Gradient clipping norm changed to 0.5
        optax.adamw(learning_rate=learning_rate, weight_decay=0.01)
    )

BASE_SEED = 7
BATCH_SIZE = 64
